env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd probe
! logos lint ./direct
stderr 'direct.go:3:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! logos lint ./paren
stderr 'paren.go:3:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
logos lint ./changed
! stderr .

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/recursivefor

go 1.27
-- probe/direct/direct.go --
package direct

func RecursiveFor(n int) int {
	for { return RecursiveFor(n) }
}
-- probe/paren/paren.go --
package paren

func RecursiveFor(n int) int {
	for { return (RecursiveFor)(n) }
}
-- probe/changed/changed.go --
package changed

func RecursiveFor(n int) int {
	for {
		if n <= 0 { return 0 }
		return RecursiveFor(n-1)
	}
}
